parameters.content:
## Accounts-Receivable Collection Engine (AI-Powered)

Receives an overdue invoice / collection request, enriches customer data, calls an AI service to generate personalized collection actions, executes the primary action, and returns a full collection plan with audit trail.

### All nodes (1-line each)
1. Webhook - Collection Request – Receives the AR collection request via POST.
2. Code - Validate & Build Customer Context – Validates the request and prepares customer risk / history context for AI.
3. Wait - Pre Customer Enrichment – Short pause before customer data enrichment.
4. HTTP Request - Fetch Customer History – Pulls payment history, previous interactions and risk indicators.
5. Wait - Pre AI Generation – Pause before AI action-generation call.
6. HTTP Request - AI Generate Actions – Calls AI service to produce customer-specific collection actions.
7. Wait - Pre Action Execution – Pause before executing the primary recommended action.
8. HTTP Request - Execute Primary Action – Sends email / creates task / triggers call / applies offer.
9. HTTP Request - Update AR / CRM – Logs the action and updates the accounts-receivable / CRM record.
10. Code - Build Collection Plan – Aggregates AI recommendations + execution results into final plan + audit trail.
11. Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete collection plan to the caller.

## 1. Intake & Customer Context

Webhook - Collection Request – Receives the AR collection request via POST.
Code - Validate & Build Customer Context – Validates the request and prepares customer risk / history context for AI.

## 2. Enrichment, AI Generation & Execution

Wait - Pre Customer Enrichment – Short pause before customer data enrichment.
HTTP Request - Fetch Customer History – Pulls payment history, previous interactions and risk indicators.
Wait - Pre AI Generation – Pause before AI action-generation call.
HTTP Request - AI Generate Actions – Calls AI service to produce customer-specific collection actions.
Wait - Pre Action Execution – Pause before executing the primary recommended action.
HTTP Request - Execute Primary Action – Sends email / creates task / triggers call / applies offer.
HTTP Request - Update AR / CRM – Logs the action and updates the accounts-receivable / CRM record.

## 3. Plan & Respond

Code - Build Collection Plan – Aggregates AI recommendations + execution results into final plan + audit trail.
Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete collection plan to the caller.
